thread:
anya (PM): quick sync — we need a concise ship-prep checklist for SLA/docs/support/pricing gaps before we hand to sales. keeping it actionable pls

mike (SRE): can we lock target SLAs first? i suggest: availability 99.95%, p99 latency < 300ms for 1-2k token gen, error rate < 0.5%

ryan (Eng): those numbers sound tight but doable with dedicated pools. question: does 300ms p99 apply to burst traffic?

mike (SRE): good call — split by route. for short sync routes (chat/complete) p99=300ms, for long streaming sessions p95=800ms. add autoscale buffer for bursts.

anya (PM): SA — can we make the SLA table explicit in the docs? need one-paragraph customer-facing summary + appendix with measurement definitions

selena (Docs): i can author the summary. need exact metric defs and test harness. mike — can you paste the SLI calc we use in ops?

mike (SRE): copying snippet we use in monitoring: ```
# SLI definitions
availability = successful_requests / total_requests
latency_p99 = 99th_percentile(request_latency_ms)
error_rate = 4xx_5xx_requests / total_requests
# window: 30d rolling for SLO, 7d for alerting
```

selena (Docs): perfect - i'll translate into plain language + one-line examples. will add a customer FAQ for how we measure tokens and billed units.

sam-oncall (Support): support rota: we need 24/7 pager for first 2 weeks after GA, then 8/5 with on-call rotation for critical incidents. also need runbook link and escalation matrix before handoff

anya (PM): runbook yes — owner? mike + ryan to draft. selena, include link in docs and product FAQ. sam — will you confirm war-room contact list by EOD?

sam-oncall (Support): will do. i'll also request a dedicated support-triage Slack channel and a template for customer severity classification.

ryan (Eng): on rollouts: we should include an automatic fallback policy to smaller model variant if tail latency spikes. that must be listed under "graceful degradation" in the ops doc

mike (SRE): adding metric alarms: p95 latency > 200ms for 5min -> page to infra; error_rate > 0.5% for 2min -> page; availability drop > 0.2% in 1h -> page. add cost-overspend alert for per-customer burst > budget%

anya (PM): pricing readiness: product should include pricing guardrails and an obvious upgrade path. finance wants a recommended default quota map for self-serve to avoid immediate spikes

ryan (Eng): propose conservative default quotas: concurrency 8, tokens/day 50k for free tier. dedicated evals by sales can bump. pls flag any customer exceptions

selena (Docs): will add a "How pricing works" explainer + screenshots of quota settings in console. also include 'how to request quota increase' flow for sales/AE

anya (PM): decision log item: require sign-off from SRE, Support lead, and Docs before we flip the GA flag. owners: mike, sam-oncall, selena. target: small shiproom on Fri.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary rollout to 5% of traffic at 2024-11-08T18:00Z. notify #product and #eng-oncall when canary completes.

mike (SRE): action items I have: draft SLO doc, add alerts, provide test harness queries. done target: Thu EOD

ryan (Eng): I'll implement fallback policy + quota enforcement. ETA: Thu EOD for PR

selena (Docs): i'll produce the one-page customer SLA + runbook links + pricing explainer. ETA: Thu EOD

sam-oncall (Support): compiling contact list and war-room process. ETA: Thu 6pm PT

anya (PM): ok — if everyone hits Thu EOD we'll do a final pre-ship sweep on Fri morning. flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
